examples.title: The Persian Wheel
examples.problem: How did the Persian Wheel help farmers?
examples.solution: It allowed them to lift water from deep wells more easily to irrigate their fields.
examples.explanation: This led to better crops and more food for the growing population.

examples.title: Rajput Valor
examples.solution: They were a group of warriors who claimed to be 'Rajaputra' (sons of kings) and were known for their bravery and loyalty.
examples.explanation: They played a major role in the political history of North India during this time.
